_note_structure: Keys 'bidang' (=Skill), 'standard_kandungan' (=Content Standard) and 'standard_pembelajaran' (=Learning Standard) reuse the engine's keys. Wording matches the official DSKP Form 3.

standard_kandungan.nama: Understand meaning in a variety of familiar contexts

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Understand independently the main ideas in simple longer texts on an increased range of familiar topics.
Understand independently specific information and details in longer texts on an increased range of familiar topics.
Recognise with little or no support attitudes or opinions in longer texts on an increased range of familiar topics.
Understand independently longer sequences of classroom instructions.
Understand independently more complex questions.
Understand independently longer simple narratives on a range of familiar topics.

standard_kandungan.nama: Use appropriate listening strategies in a variety of contexts

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Guess the meaning of unfamiliar words from clues provided by other words and by context on an increased range of familiar topics.

standard_kandungan.nama: Recognise features of spoken genres on familiar topics

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Recognise with support typical features at word, sentence and text levels of a small number of spoken genres.

standard_kandungan.nama: Communicate information, ideas, opinions and feelings intelligibly on familiar topics

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Paraphrase short simple texts.
Ask about and explain simple processes.
Describe future plans and ambitions.
Explain own point of view.
Express and respond to common feelings such as happiness, sadness, surprise and interest.
Use formal and informal registers appropriately in some familiar contexts.
Keep interaction going in longer exchanges by asking a speaker to slow down, speak up or to repeat what they have said.

standard_kandungan.nama: Communicate appropriately to a small or large group on familiar topics

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Summarise the main points of a story.

standard_kandungan.nama: Understand a variety of texts by using a range of appropriate reading strategies to construct meaning

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Understand the main points in longer texts on an increased range of familiar topics.
Understand specific details and information in longer texts on an increased range of familiar topics.
Guess the meaning of unfamiliar words from clues provided by other words and by context on an increased range of familiar topics.
Use independently familiar print and digital resources to check meaning and extend understanding.
Recognise with support the attitude or opinion of the writer in simple longer texts on an increased range of familiar topics.
Recognise with support typical features at word, sentence and text levels of a range of genres.

standard_kandungan.nama: Explore and expand ideas for personal development by reading independently and widely

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Read, enjoy and give a personal response to fiction or non-fiction and other suitable print and digital texts of interest.

standard_kandungan.nama: Communicate intelligibly through print and digital media on familiar topics

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Explain simple content from what they have read or heard.
Explain simple processes.
Summarise the main points and explain key details of a story, text or plot.
Express and respond to opinions and common feelings such as happiness, sadness, surprise, and interest.
Organise, sequence and develop ideas within short texts on familiar topics.

standard_kandungan.nama: Communicate with appropriate language, form and style

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Punctuate written work with moderate accuracy.
Spell written work with moderate accuracy.
Produce a plan or draft of two paragraphs or more and modify this appropriately independently.
Begin to use formal and informal registers appropriate to the target audience in familiar situations.

standard_kandungan.nama: Engage with, respond to and interpret a variety of literary text types

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Explain why a part or aspect of a text interests them.
Explain briefly the development of plot, characters and themes in a text.

standard_kandungan.nama: Analyse and evaluate a variety of literary text types

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Identify key stylistic features of a text and explain briefly why the author uses them.

standard_kandungan.nama: Express an imaginative response to literary texts

standard_pembelajaran.huraian: Respond imaginatively and intelligibly through creating power points, visuals, posters, blogs and webpages.
